title: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request modification of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to reject a PDU session modification request.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejection of the PDU session modification request.

entities.name: Procedure not accepted by the network
entities.description: Condition where the network rejects the UE's request for PDU session modification.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
When the network does not accept the procedure, it sends a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.
The PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains a 5GSM cause IE indicating the rejection reason.
